card: Keep chosen stops in place on a driver route.
title: Waylock for the stops that must stay
intro: Waylock lets a driver hold chosen stops in place and reorder the rest. A wrong turn does not erase the intended route.

sections.heading: Who is Waylock for?
sections.body: Drivers and couriers use it on Android alongside Google Maps.

sections.heading: How are stops ordered?
sections.body: Hold the stops that matter in place, then arrange the others around them.

sections.heading: What happens after a wrong turn?
sections.body: If you stray, the route you chose remains on screen; you can return to it or accept another.

sections.heading: Where does Waylock fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps appointments and saved places beside people. Waylock works on the drive itself, holding chosen stops in place as the route changes.
